summary: Institutional positioning is heavily concentrated in long-term, "LEAPS" hedging and directional bets on the SPX, characterized by massive premium in the 7000C and 8000P strikes for late 2026. The dominant pattern is a massive, multi-day accumulation of SPX 7000C (exps 2026-09 and 2026-12) totaling over $4B, paired with significant $1.6B+ accumulation in 8000P, suggesting a "strangle" style positioning or a massive long-term volatility play. In the semiconductor space, aggressive bullish conviction is evident in AMD (P/C 0.26), TSLA (P/C 0.30), and NVDA (P/C 0.32), all showing heavy BuyCall dominance. Traders should watch for continued price action around the SPX 7000 level and monitor if the heavy semiconductor call buying leads to a momentum breakout in the tech sector.
